limitations: Only two symmetric sites, unit-lengthscale normalized Gaussian and Matern-3/2 kernels, known zero mean, exactly observed noisy values, Bayes squared loss. No global assertion for asymmetric designs or all kernels.
scientific_integrity: Proof stated for independent Gaussian observation noise and one normalized stationary prior at a time; both normalized priors are compared with the same noise variance. All computations augment an analytic all-positive-noise theorem; publication priority has not been independently verified.
title: A squared-radius duality for noisy two-point Gaussian-process differentiation
